guardHypothesis.velocity: Retain published side when actual 3s AND 10s moves both oppose fitted moves over those SAME past intervals.
guardHypothesis.residual: Retain published side when current price residual exceeds twice the fitted historical RMS residual.
guardHypothesis.combined: Retain published side when either fixed condition is met.
guardHypothesis.timing: Same published admission and entry time; no time confirmation, cooldown, confidence threshold or deletion of calls.
guardHypothesis.thresholds: No optimization against video outcomes; all guard variants retained in report.

breakHypothesis.selection: Line, one broken line, line+cycle, best broken line+cycle; BIC plus searched-model penalty
breakHypothesis.admission: Keep every published entry at the same instant. No additional wait or confidence gate.

scope: Same user video, follow-up exploratory study. Not independent market validation.
